[[File:Raid-Chip.png|right]]'''Raid Chips''' are a currency used to purchase items in the Raid Store. They are primarily earned through [[Raid]]s, but they can be also earned through [[Away Mission]]s and [[Alliance Quest]]s.

Your Raid Chip stash, unlike other currencies, is fluid, as they can be stolen from your Base by other Commanders. A successful attack an a base gives a Commander 10% of the opponent Commander's current amount of chips. A successful base defense gives a Commander around 500-600 Raid Chips. Defeating a Base Defender also gives a small amount of Raid Chips; the higher the Bot's rating, the more chips awarded.

It is recommended to leave Raid Chips earned in Alliance Quests unclaimed as a temporary untouchable stash so you can later use them if you are a few chips short from getting a certain item.
